title: InterWeave contract meta-schema
description: The schema every InterWeave wire contract is validated against. It constrains the envelope — identity, provenance, and lifecycle status — not the wire shape itself. A contract that does not name the ADR and prose specification it derives from is unreviewable, so both are required.

$schema.description: One dialect across the corpus. A mixed-dialect set silently changes validation semantics between files.

$id.description: urn:interweave:schemas:<family>:<concept>. Checked against the file's own path by the validator.

status.description: What this contract is authoritative ABOUT. `active`/`deprecated` describe the CURRENT wire. `approved` is an authoritative implementation TARGET and is never a claim that anything implements it. `proposed` is a review artifact and MUST NOT drive implementation. Every contract in this repository is `approved` until an implementation exists.

version.description: Contract version, independent of the wire protocol version it describes.

adr.description: The ADR(s) that decided this shape. Existence is checked against architecture/adr/.

specification.description: The prose contract this schema formalises. Existence is checked. The prose remains normative for behaviour; the schema is normative for shape.

wire-protocol.description: The libp2p protocol identifier this shape travels on, where one applies.

fixtures.description: Frozen vector files exercising this contract. Existence is checked; the vectors themselves are recomputed by verify_fixture_vectors.py.
